name: staggered leg side bridge
description: A side plank with the feet placed one in front of the other for a different base. It trains the obliques and hips.
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder.
Stagger your feet, top foot in front of the bottom one.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep the hips high and avoid rolling forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
